Package org.webharvest.ioc

Interface AttributeHolder

  • All Known Implementing Classes:
    ScopeAttributeHolder
    public interface AttributeHolder
    Implementors of this interface can serve as the backing store for Objects that are scoped within an (subclass of) AttributeHolderScope. Based on work of Matthias Treydte .
    Since:
    2.1.0-SNAPSHOT
    Version:
    %I%, %G%
    Author:
    Robert Bala

    • Method Detail

      • getAttribute

        Object getAttribute​(Object key)
        Extracts the Object memorized for the specified key from this AttributeHolder.
        Parameters:
        key - the identifier for the attribute to extract
        Returns:
        the Object stored for the specified key, or null if either the null value was stored for this key or there is no attribute stored for the key
        See Also:
        to discriminate the two reasons this method may return

      • hasAttribute

        boolean hasAttribute​(Object key)
        Decides if this AttributeHolder has an association for the specified key.
        Parameters:
        key - the key to check if it's known to this AttributeHolder
        Returns:
        if this key is known

      • putAttribute

        void putAttribute​(Object key,
                  Object value)
        Stores a new value in this AttributeHolder.
        Parameters:
        key - the key to identify the new attribute
        value - the new attribute

      • getAttributeLock

        Object getAttributeLock()
        Returns an object on which to lock when access to multiple methods of the AttributeHolder are to be made atomic.
        Returns:
        the Object to synchronize on
